text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Did you leave this on my desk,<n>Ayabe? It was you,
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It must be a birthday present... I knew<n>it! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's nothing special. Only a heated<n>eye mask.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I really appreciate it! I'm going<n>to try it out
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Seriously... It's just a mask that I<n>always use.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That means you must really like it!And you're kind enough to share itwith me! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But, Ayabe, you put so much thought<n>into a present
for me. That makes me<n>really happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I bet you knew my eyes have been<n>tired from
watching racing videos<n>nonstop. Hehe, ehehe...
